description: This file implements Zigbee event handling callbacks for a Zigbee subsystem, managing device discovery, device join/announce events, and system state updates within a Zigbee network.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the Zigbee network and sets addresses during system startup.

methods.name: saveJoinAnnounceInfo
methods.description: Stores join or announce info for a device in a hash map, indicating whether the device has joined and its type and power source.

methods.name: clearJoinAnnounceInfo
methods.description: Removes device info from the hash map based on EUI64.

methods.name: processNewDevice
methods.description: Discovers and processes a new device after it has joined or announced.

methods.name: deviceAnnounced
methods.description: Handles device announcement events, deciding whether to process the device based on its known/recovery state.

methods.name: deviceJoined
methods.description: Handles device join events, deciding whether to process the device based on its known/recovery state.

methods.name: deviceLeft
methods.description: Logs device leaving events.

methods.name: deviceRejoined
methods.description: Handles device rejoining events, notifying the subsystem.

methods.name: linkKeyUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to link keys for devices.

methods.name: apsAckFailure
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment failures in Zigbee communication.

methods.name: attributeReportReceived
methods.description: Processes received attribute reports from devices.

methods.name: clusterCommandReceived
methods.description: Processes received cluster commands, filtering out specific clusters.

methods.name: deviceFirmwareUpgradingEventReceived
methods.description: Handles device firmware upgrading events.

methods.name: deviceFirmwareUpgradeCompletedEventReceived
methods.description: Handles completion of device firmware upgrades.

methods.name: deviceFirmwareUpgradeFailedEventReceived
methods.description: Handles failed device firmware upgrades.

methods.name: deviceFirmwareVersionNotifyEventReceived
methods.description: Handles firmware version notifications from devices.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful device communication, petting watchdog and updating contact time.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationFailed
methods.description: Handles failed device communication, forcing device into failure state.

methods.name: networkConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles network configuration changes, saving the new config if system is ready.

methods.name: networkHealthProblem
methods.description: Handles network health problem notifications.

methods.name: networkHealthProblemRestored
methods.description: Handles restoration of network health.

methods.name: panIdAttackDetected
methods.description: Handles detection of PAN ID attacks.

methods.name: panIdAttackCleared
methods.description: Handles clearing of PAN ID attack status.

methods.name: zigbeeEventHandlerInit
methods.description: Initializes callback functions for Zigbee events.

methods.name: zigbeeEventHandlerSystemReady
methods.description: Sets system as ready to process events.

methods.name: zigbeeEventHandlerDiscoveryRunning
methods.description: Resets or clears device state when discovery process starts or stops.
